model_output.verdict: A marketing executive with a clear record of leading teams and growing revenue across technology companies.
write_up: This is a strong executive marketing resume! From NexGen through Novara, you show the teams and budgets you led alongside changes in revenue, acquisition costs and customer retention. A recruiter can see both the work and the business results.

The Viridian account-based marketing line is a model: it names the program, its annual pipeline contribution and the change in win rates among Fortune 500 clients. Your experience leads the resume, and the Chief Marketing Officer role gives a clear picture of your remit.
Start with the Novara product launch line and add what changed in the process. Your resume is unlikely to be the reason you don't get a call back; competition for executive roles will also matter.
